title: Helsinki information graphics in print
slide_intent: Organize data with several complementary forms because readers compare quantities, facts and categories in different ways.
strategic_value: The shared colors and type can make Helsinki’s dense civic information recognizable across a publication.
demonstration: This webpage photograph shows an open publication with icons, prominent figures, donut and bar charts on the left and blue tabular rows on the right.
practical_value: Match data type to chart, callout or table while preserving a shared page hierarchy.
